mechanism: In the event-to-TraceItem attribute encoding path, the tag-extraction step reads event_data["tags"] and directly iterates over it to build the attribute map. event_data["tags"] is not guaranteed to be a list — for some events it is explicitly None rather than absent or an empty list — and the code iterates it without first checking for None. Iterating a None value raises a TypeError, so any event whose tags field is None crashes attribute encoding instead of simply producing zero tag attributes.
proposed_remedy: Check that event_data["tags"] is not None before iterating over it (e.g. skip/guard the loop when tags is None), so a None tags value yields no tag attributes rather than raising.
